exposure: Vaginal delivery vs. cesarean delivery among macrosomic births
Macrosomic birth vs. normal birth weight
finding: Macrosomic births were associated with higher maternal weight, higher gestational age, increased rates of cesarean delivery, asphyxia, and shoulder dystocia.
mod_finding: Caesarean delivery was significantly associated with macrosomic births compared to controls, and the majority of asphyxiated babies amongst macroomic births were following vaginal delivery compared to caesarean delivery.
